hypothesis: createReservationItems_ reads inventory levels with a plain list (no row lock), then writes reserved_quantity as the value read plus the adjustment. Two concurrent completions touching the same inventory level can both read the same reserved_quantity, so one increment is lost: the reserved counter then disagrees with the sum of live reservation rows. With WIDGET stocked at 10, two carts of OVS-PIECE should both succeed and reserve 1 each, so the lost update should show as reserved_quantity != live reservation sum. The oversell check may also trip if stock is tight.
